name: AMUD-Agent
description: Telemetry sidecar for **AMUD Dashboard**. Uses **host network** so bandwidth mapping sees real Unraid NICs (`eth0`, `bond0`, `br0`, etc.). Optionally bind-mount array/cache paths for disk telemetry mapping. **Install AMUD Dashboard first**. Agent Secret and Socket Path must match the dashboard container exactly. For **Settings → Host telemetry mapping** (disk + network), enable the optional **Array** and **Cache** path mappings below when you use `/mnt/user` or `/mnt/cache` in settings. Docs: https://boubli.github.io/AMUD-Dashboard/docs/installation/Unraid

paths.name: Agent Socket Dir
paths.description: Shared directory for the Unix socket. Must match the AMUD Dashboard container exactly.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Read-only Docker socket for container discovery and stats.

paths.name: Array Mount (Unraid)
paths.description: Optional. Bind Unraid array path for disk telemetry mapping (/mnt/user in Settings).

paths.name: Cache Mount (Unraid)
paths.description: Optional. Bind Unraid cache pool for disk telemetry mapping (/mnt/cache in Settings).

variables.name: Agent Secret
variables.description: Must be identical to the value on the AMUD Dashboard container.

variables.name: Docker Monitoring
variables.description: 1 = enable Docker container telemetry (recommended on Unraid). 0 = host metrics only.

variables.name: AMUD_SOCKET_PATH
variables.description: Unix socket path inside the container.

variables.name: PVE API Token
variables.description: Optional. Proxmox API token if you also monitor PVE from this agent.
